baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative أَخْرَجَ, the source phrase مِنْهَا, and the paired possessives in مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth is an interior whose concealed hydrological and vegetative capacities pass into visibility: water appears from within it and pasture becomes available outside it.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment makes the focus verb a disclosure from an interior, not merely a change of location.
Water becoming present and abundant in land supplies the hidden hydrological capacity that is disclosed.
Grazable growth and its place supply the visible vegetative counterpart to the released water.

changed_reading.before: The earth simply produces water and pasture.
changed_reading.after: The earth discloses paired life-supporting capacities that had been held within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated objects مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا under one causative verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water is not inert inventory but something conveyed in watering, while pasture carries both feeding and preservation; their coordination forms an ongoing support circuit.

activation_trace.role: Passage outward supplies the enabling movement by which the earth's resources become accessible.
Conveying water through watering turns the first object into a continuing delivery function.
Shepherding, preservation, and care make pasture the sustaining side of the paired mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Water and pasture are two created commodities.
changed_reading.after: Their emergence establishes a continuing ecology of delivery, feeding, and care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening activates a water-filled earth from which water can be drawn, revising مِنْهَا from a generic source marker into the mouth of a saturated hidden store.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure from concealment anchors extraction in the focus verb.
Water appearing abundantly in the ground supplies the concealed store being extracted.
Hand-drawn water contributes the concrete extraction motion assigned to the focus's causative emergence.
Ground filled with water supplies the saturated interior from which extraction can occur.

structural_cues: 79:1 places the two triggering roots together at the opening, before the surah's return-to-surface and earth-making sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: drawn water and water-filled ground. Reader arrow: saturation creates a hidden reservoir from which أَخْرَجَ extracts. Live alternative: the opening images may remain independent oath motions without specifying the focus's hydrology.

changed_reading.before: The earth brings water into existence or availability.
changed_reading.after: The earth releases water by drawing it from a saturated interior reservoir.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ecology becomes an administered cultivation: foresighted ordering directs growth, while lordship is imaged as repair, nurture, and completion rather than bare possession.

activation_trace.role: Delivered watering supplies the operational means of cultivation.
Preserving care supplies the governing function embodied in the pasture.
Planning with regard to outcomes makes the productive sequence administered rather than accidental.
Growth and increase give the directed affair a productive ecological result.
Repair, upbringing, and completion render lordship as the cultivation that brings the paired outputs to usefulness.
The split root's nourishment and growth image sharpens the developmental mechanism without replacing the cited root.

structural_cues: The opening motion sequence culminates at 79:5 in management of an affair, while ر ب ب recurs through the Moses scene, Pharaoh's rival claim, and the closing account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: outcome-aware management, growth, and nurturing completion. Reader arrow: these operations govern the water-pasture pair as cultivation. Live alternative: the roots may characterize cosmic and moral sovereignty broadly without detailing an ecological process.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a self-contained act of producing resources.
changed_reading.after: It displays lordship as the administered nurturing of an ecology toward completed usefulness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A valley channel and the movement of herd animals back and forth between water and pasture convert the focus's paired nouns into the two stations of a managed circulation system.

activation_trace.role: Watering and conveyance make water one active station in the circuit.
The grazing place supplies the circuit's complementary feeding station.
Alternating herd animals between water and pasture supplies the exact circulation linking the focus's two objects.
A valley as a flood channel gives that circulation a concrete spatial conduit.

structural_cues: 79:16 co-locates the call and the valley, and 79:23 repeats the call-root before the earth sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a valley watercourse and herd movement between water and pasture. Reader arrow: channel flow enables recurring herd circulation between the focus's paired resources. Live alternative: the two branch images may activate separately rather than define one managed system.

changed_reading.before: Water and pasture are adjacent products.
changed_reading.after: They are interdependent stations in a valley-based circulation of water, animals, feeding, and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same causative disclosure pattern first makes daylight emerge and then makes a fertile lower surface yield water and pasture; the focus is one phase in a coordinated transition from concealed to inhabitable visibility.

activation_trace.role: Making the concealed visible anchors the repeated disclosure operation in the focus verb.
Water's appearance in land realizes disclosure materially below.
Emergence into sunlight and visibility supplies the immediately preceding celestial version of disclosure.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive substrate whose capacities become visible in the focus.

structural_cues: 79:29 repeats أَخْرَجَ with daylight, and 79:30 places the earth immediately before the focus's أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: visible daylight, fertile ground, and the exact repeated causative verb. Reader arrow: the repetition makes both daylight and terrestrial fertility phases of disclosure. Live alternative: the syntax may simply coordinate distinct creative acts without imposing one concealment-to-visibility mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes terrestrial production alone.
changed_reading.after: It is the terrestrial counterpart of daylight's disclosure, turning the ordered world into a visible and inhabitable field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mobile water and grazing growth are set between a spread earth and anchored solid elevations, allowing the focus to be read as the productive flow component of a stable terrain system.

activation_trace.role: Conveyed water supplies the mobile component whose course depends on terrain.
Grazable growth supplies the distributed biological result of water moving through that terrain.
Solid elevated masses supply the terrain relief around the focus's mobile outputs.
Fixity and rooted stability make the elevations the stable frame for hydrological distribution.

structural_cues: The focus is bracketed by the spreading of earth at 79:30 and the anchoring of mountains at 79:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: spread ground, solid elevations, stable anchoring, conveyed water, and pasture. Reader arrow: stable relief channels water and distributes growth. Live alternative: the sequence may inventory benefits without asserting terrain controls on water.

changed_reading.before: The earth independently emits water and pasture.
changed_reading.after: Their emergence is the mobile, productive layer of a shaped and stabilized terrain system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following purpose phrase assigns the water-pasture pair an audience and use: it is usable provision shared across human and herd life, not a spectacle detached from consumers.

activation_trace.role: Watering makes the first output practically usable by living consumers.
Grazable pasture directly supplies herd use and indirectly supports human subsistence.
A useful means for needs and subsistence converts the outputs into provision with a practical endpoint.
Livestock wealth identifies the nonhuman consumers for whom pasture and water are made available.

structural_cues: 79:33 immediately follows the focus and mountain clause as a purpose or result expression addressed to 'you' and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: practical benefit and livestock as explicit beneficiaries. Reader arrow: the purpose phrase scopes retrospectively over the focus's paired outputs. Live alternative: its scope may cover the entire 79:27-32 creation sequence rather than privilege 79:31.

changed_reading.before: The water and pasture demonstrate creative power.
changed_reading.after: They are a deliberately accessible commons of subsistence spanning human and animal life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return from a prior condition and the earth's life through rain and plants turn the focus sequence into a material miniature of revival: concealed water is released, growth becomes available, and a seemingly inert surface supports life again.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment gives the focus the transition needed for a revival analogy.
Watering supplies the causal medium by which terrestrial life can return.
Visible grazing growth supplies the living result of released water.
Return to a former place or condition supplies the surah's disputed transition that the focus can model materially.
Earth revived by rain and vegetation explicitly joins the focus's water and pasture into one life-restoring process.

structural_cues: 79:10-14 moves from denial of return after decayed bones to sudden presence on the surface, while 79:34-41 resumes eschatological arrival and outcome after the creation block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: return, surface reappearance, and earth-life through rain and plants. Reader arrow: the focus's water-to-growth sequence is an observable analogue for bodily return. Live alternative: it may remain evidence of power or provision without modeling resurrection's process.

changed_reading.before: The verse belongs only to the creation and provision inventory.
changed_reading.after: Its hydrology and growth enact a small-scale, visible grammar of return to life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's outputs sustain an interval rather than an absolute home: provision is retained for use, the catastrophe interrupts the creation inventory, and retrospective perception compresses the stay.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary water supplies the basic resource on which the temporary interval depends.
Preservation through pasture gives the interval its sustaining function.
Retention extended for enjoyment supplies duration while still implying provision can end.
Remaining in a place supplies the measured stay that final perception radically shortens.

structural_cues: 79:33 closes the creation sequence with provision, 79:34 immediately opens the overwhelming event, and 79:46 compares the whole stay to part of a day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: retained provision, an abrupt eschatological transition, and a retrospectively brief stay. Reader arrow: the focus resources maintain a bounded terrestrial interval. Live alternative: 79:46 may describe only perceived duration and not qualify the function of 79:31.

changed_reading.before: Water and pasture establish the earth as a durable habitat.
changed_reading.after: They provision a deliberately bounded stay whose apparent permanence collapses at the surah's final horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps material water and grazing onto the ethics of appetite. It remains anchored in the focus through the pasture root's branch of refraining and through the paired water whose overflow branch figures excess; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain analogy, not as the lexical meaning of مَرْعَىٰهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَرْعَىٰهَا through the ر ع ي branch of refraining, coordinated with مَآءَهَا.

activation_trace.role: Refraining and turning back from wrong anchors pasture to a controlled rather than indiscriminate appetite.
Literal water supplies the material whose bounded availability contrasts with overflow.
Water rising beyond bounds supplies the material image for transgressive excess.
Restraint from action supplies the ethical boundary imposed on appetite.
The soul's inclination supplies the appetite that must be pastured rather than allowed to overflow.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes an external ecology for bodily feeding.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, that bounded ecology also images the governance of desire: nourishment is provided, but appetite is not sovereign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the non-dominant mapped branch of a split root used textually for seeing, so it is form-distant. It remains anchored to the focus's explicit water and watering branch, but downstream prose must label water-carrying as a split-root echo rather than an intended sense of the context verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَآءَهَا under أَخْرَجَ, especially the water-delivery branch of م و ه.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage anchors the final emergence of water in the focus.
Watering and conveyance anchor a delivery stage before visible emergence.
The split target's carrying and bringing of water activates a transport vector feeding the focus's outward release.

changed_reading.before: Water simply emerges at the earth's surface.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the emergence is the visible endpoint of an unseen delivery route carrying water into position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a closing temporal endpoint activates a branch image of water collecting where a flood ends. It remains anchored in the focus's water appearing from the ground, but downstream prose should qualify the basin-and-release cycle as a material analogy, not transfer the hydrological branch directly onto the Hour's endpoint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا as water emerging from an earth that can also collect it.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure from an interior anchors the release side of the proposed cycle.
Water accumulating and appearing in land anchors the collection side of the cycle.
A water basin at the terminus of flood flow supplies an endpoint where dispersed water gathers before renewed release.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts one-way ejection of water from earth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it catches one phase of a collection-and-release cycle in which earth is both basin and source.

strongest_changes: The ن د و branch of herd movement between water and pasture, joined to the valley watercourse, changes two nouns into a managed circulation system.
The repeated causative disclosure of daylight and the immediate earth-mountain-purpose sequence integrate 79:31 into a visible, stable, usable habitat.
The explicit earth-life branch linking rain and vegetation lets the focus function as a material analogue of the return disputed earlier in the surah.
The closing temporal compression changes provision from a permanent setting into support for a bounded terrestrial interval.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation exposed unusually exact operational links: water and pasture as alternating herd stations, valley flow as their conduit, lordship as cultivation, and provision as both revival evidence and temporary maintenance. The strongest changes arose from mechanisms and sequence rather than topical grouping.
remaining_uncertainties: مِنْهَا securely marks relation to earth, but the degree to which it entails a pre-existing subterranean store remains inferential.
The retrospective scope of 79:33 may cover all of 79:27-32 rather than specifically foreground the focus's water and pasture.
The resurrection model may be an analogy of power and observable revival rather than a claim that 79:31 depicts resurrection's process.
Split-root and cross-domain outliers remain useful activations only when clearly distinguished from contextual lexical senses.
